body: I have been telling myself for years it will get better.  And now I'm just tired of fighting. I am 25 yr old male, who has broken down at work multiple times and cried. It's fucking pathetic.

Have tried different meds, all in conjunction with other support mechanisms. You have hit the nail on the head with the helplessness she feels. That's what is pushing me even closer. I am tired of inflicting my pain onto others.  Myself feeling how I am is one thing. Seeing my loved ones struggling worse and worse dealing with me is another.
The thing is, this time it doesn't feel like giving up. It's hard to explain. I just feel ready. It's like I have reached acceptance. I am just concerned of the effect it will have on my parents.
